---
Test
---
!3 A page AFTER the death still runs - and still learns the FIRST cause

This page proves the two properties that decide whether a run stays readable: it shows up in the
result at all, and it is told '''why''' - not just that something is broken. Without the first cause
being carried along, every page after a host death would only say "is marked broken" and the actual
finding would be in no result any more.

!|script   |!-SlimProxy.Core-!|
|show      |target status     |
|check     |ping target|Sim   |=~/is broken since/|
|check not |ping target|Sim   |OK|
|check     |target status     |=~/BROKEN since/|
